p: Darlington will always be linked with the railways. The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in 1825, and the Head of Steam museum at the old North Road station is a great stop if you want the full story.

Crown Street sits right in the town centre, close to the library and a short walk from the market hall and the Cornmill Centre, so it's easy to fold a visit into a shopping trip. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means 18+ only and nothing for the kids. Darlington's town centre has plenty of pubs, independent cafés and places to eat, especially around the market square and Skinnergate, so you're spoilt for choice when it comes to a sit-down and something to eat.
